title: Signed link statement
description: The object the device signs (RFC 8785 canonical form, ES256) when the user links, or refuses to link, a relying party on the phone (protocol 1.2, spec section 14.3). An `approve` is signed by the approval key, a `deny` by either key.

client_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the relying party's client_id, as the server showed it to the device.

domain.description: The proven domain the server showed to the device, or null when the party has none. Signing it makes the user's decision about that domain.

binding_code.description: The code the user typed; the empty string for an explicit Deny before any code was typed.

nonce.description: The nonce of the link request the device fetched.

issued_at.description: Unix time in seconds; accepted within 300 seconds of the server's clock.

kid.description: The key id of the device key that signs.
